Azo compounds, diazo compounds, and hydrazines all contain nitrogen-nitrogen bonds. These N-N bonds are relatively weak and can be easily broken, especially in the presence of strong reducing agents.

When strong reducing agents interact with these compounds:
1. The reduction can be highly exothermic (releasing heat)
2. The nitrogen-nitrogen bonds can break rapidly
3. This can lead to the rapid release of nitrogen gas (N₂)
4. The sudden decomposition and gas release can cause explosions
5. The reactions can be unpredictable and potentially violent
